newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HICOR MAKES OFFER TO ALLWEAR SHAREHOLDERS.
newsitem.headline: HICOR MAKES OFFER TO ALLWEAR SHAREHOLDERS.

text.p: Hicor Ltd said on Wednesday it had offered to acquire all the shares of clothing manufacturer Allwear Ltd for 3.5 new ordinary Hicor shares for every share held or 220 cents a share in cash.
Hicor currently holds 61.3 percent of Allwear and plans to delist Allwear on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) after acquiring all its shares.
It said about 48 percent of Allwear shareholders had accepted the Hicor offer and the maximum amount that may become payable to Allwear shareholders by Hicor was about 6.3 million rand.

The effects of the offer on Hicor for the year ended December 31, assuming that the offer was effective throughout the financial year, would be to raise earnings per share to 9.6 cents from 7.6 cents.
Hicor will apply to the JSE to list the new Hicor shares with effect from a date after the closing of the offer.
